name: PRISM 800m Meteorology Variables
description: Population-weighted ZCTA aggregations of PRISM 800-meter meteorological variables. PRISM (Parameter-elevation Regressions on Independent Slopes Model) provides gridded climate and weather estimates including temperature, precipitation, dew point temperature, vapor pressure deficit, and solar radiation. The pipeline aggregates daily PRISM rasters to census blocks and then applies Census block population weights to produce ZCTA-level daily and yearly files.

content.Source citation: PRISM Group, Oregon State University, https://prism.oregonstate.edu/terms/

name: PRISM 800m Meteorology Variables - ZCTA Daily
description: ZCTA-level daily population-weighted aggregations of PRISM 800-meter meteorological variables.

content.day: Date: Date of the PRISM estimate
content.tmax_C: Float64: Population-weighted daily maximum temperature (deg C)
content.tmin_C: Float64: Population-weighted daily minimum temperature (deg C)
content.tmean_C: Float64: Population-weighted daily mean temperature (deg C)
content.tdmean_C: Float64: Population-weighted daily mean dew point temperature (deg C)
content.ppt: Float64: Population-weighted daily total precipitation, including rain and melted snow (mm)
content.vpdmax: Float64: Population-weighted daily maximum vapor pressure deficit (hPa)
content.vpdmin: Float64: Population-weighted daily minimum vapor pressure deficit (hPa)
content.solslope: Float64: Population-weighted daily global shortwave solar radiation on a sloped surface (MJ m-2 day-1)
content.soltotal: Float64: Population-weighted daily global shortwave solar radiation on a horizontal surface (MJ m-2 day-1)
content.year: Int64: Year of the PRISM estimate

name: PRISM 800m Meteorology Variables - ZCTA Yearly
description: ZCTA-level yearly summaries of daily population-weighted PRISM 800-meter meteorological variables. Yearly values are computed as annual means of the daily ZCTA-level estimates.

content.year: Int64: Year of the PRISM estimate
